environment: macOS (Darwin 25.6), Python 3.14.7, Node v24.19.0, git; branches.py imported by path from a scratch cwd with python3 -I; CLI through the testkit cli-runner; base seed 720361592

cases.title: The module surface has tail and name with the spec signatures and imports only the standard library
cases.when: a consumer imports branches by path with python3 -I and lists the public names and signatures
cases.then: tail is (kind, **parts), name is (fmt, kind, **parts), KINDS holds verify and attempt, and only stdlib modules are imported
cases.expected: tail is (kind, **parts), name is (fmt, kind, **parts), KINDS holds verify and attempt, and only stdlib modules are imported
cases.actual: Signatures as expected; KINDS has verify and attempt; modules argparse, json, os, re, subprocess, sys
cases.specSource: R-009 and R-010 acceptance (the name command builds the tail)

evidence.title: surface listing
evidence.inline:
tail(kind, **parts)
name(fmt, kind, **parts)
split(fmt); load_format(repo); validate_format(fmt); Fail
KINDS=('run','slice','milestone','e2e','e2e-area','state','verify','attempt')
NAME_PARTS=('id','n','area','round','profile','part')
modules: argparse json os re subprocess sys (all stdlib)
full listing: .sdlc/slices/S-005/verification/r0/logs/contract-0-run.txt

cases.title: name(fmt, "state") gives state- and 14 UTC digits under six time zones and four formats
cases.given: TZ in Pacific/Kiritimati, America/Adak, Etc/GMT+12, Etc/GMT-14, Asia/Kathmandu, UTC
cases.when: name is called for sdlc/{name}, feature/PROJ-1-{name}, feature/PROJ-1-{name:lower}, x/{name}/y with five sets of extra parts
cases.then: each result is prefix + state- + 14 digits + suffix, and the digits lie between the UTC times taken before and after the call
cases.expected: each result is prefix + state- + 14 digits + suffix, and the digits lie between the UTC times taken before and after the call
cases.actual: All 126 calls in the UTC window; extra parts never change the tail

evidence.inline:

TZ=Etc/GMT+12 tail=state-20261009065033 window=[20261009065033,20261009065033]
(six zones, see .sdlc/slices/S-005/verification/r0/logs/contract-0-run.txt)

cases.title: Property: the state name stays in the UTC window for any format and any extra parts

cases.then: every result matches the reference model prefix + state-<UTC %Y%m%d%H%M%S> + suffix
cases.expected: every result matches the reference model prefix + state-<UTC %Y%m%d%H%M%S> + suffix

evidence.inline:

cases.title: Property: any 14-digit ts passes through unchanged under any format
cases.given: random 14-digit ts strings and nine formats

cases.title: Corner ts values are recorded and never raise an exception
cases.given: ts 0, '0', 1.5, True, False, a list, traversal, '/', whitespace, newline, ESC, '@{-1}', 300 chars, Arabic digits
cases.then: no uncaught exception; 0 and '0' give sdlc/state-0
cases.expected: no uncaught exception; 0 and '0' give sdlc/state-0
cases.actual: All return; the name is not ref-checked (seed)

evidence.title: corner ts
evidence.inline:
ts=0 -> sdlc/state-0
ts=true -> sdlc/state-True
ts="../../x" -> sdlc/state-../../x
ts="2026\n" -> sdlc/state-2026\n
ts="@{-1}" -> sdlc/state-@{-1}
(full list in .sdlc/slices/S-005/verification/r0/logs/contract-0-run.txt)

seeds.title: name() returns ref-unsafe names for hostile parts
seeds.detail: tail and name do not pass the result through git check-ref-format. ts '../../x', '@{-1}', a newline, profile 'a b' or ESC give names that git refuses. The spec does not bound name inputs.

seeds.title: Negative, boolean and float parts give names that parse cannot read back
seeds.detail: round -1 gives S-001-v-1-..., n -1 gives S-001-attempt--1, round False gives vFalse. The CLI int() type rejects some forms, but the API accepts all of them.

seeds.title: Fail message grammar for kinds that start with a vowel
seeds.detail: The message reads 'a attempt branch name needs a non-empty n'. The message names the part as required, but the article is wrong.
